name: OS Client Certs -- decrypt & re-encrypt S/MIME forward
description: When forwarding an S/MIME encrypted message, automatically decrypt the original, replace the raw smime.p7m blob with the decrypted content and attachments, and re-enable S/MIME encryption for the new recipients. Requires identity with S/MIME signing/encryption certificates. v0.3.2 (TEST): ForwardIntercept redirects forward->reply (clears recipients, Re: -> Fwd: at compose-open); debug-only probe now also reads the parent compose window's gMsgComposeFields.attachments to determine whether standalone files (e.g. of a decrypted embedded container) are carried into the reply or must be extracted.
